name: Chiara Farrell
source:
A staff of the information division of the "Company", [url=/c579]JB's[/url] assistant and junior. She is a mixed-blood with 2/3 of Japanese and 1/3 of African. Therefore, she has a brown skin and silvery hair as her characteristics. Because of the nature of her work, she worries about her weight increasing due to her intemperance eating habits.

[From [url=http://vnsharing.net/forum/showthread.php?t=302644/]Shiori-chan's review[/url].]
